title: Measure of Success for New Healthy Longevity Clinic
what_it_is: Measure of Success for New Healthy Longevity Clinic

sections.label: Healthy Longevity Clinic research project
sections.summary: The Healthy Longevity Clinic at Alexandra Hospital is a research project recruiting participants, with no current plans for services at polyclinics and other public hospitals.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Health (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: The launch of the Healthy Longevity Clinic at Alexandra Hospital was very well covered in the media and generated much public interest.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Health (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: It is essentially a research project to try to develop effective and practical interventions for the future.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Health (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: The clinic is therefore recruiting research participants for now, and there are currently no plans for the longevity clinic services to be offered at polyclinics and other public hospitals.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Health (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: But we hope with investments in research and development in longevity science and supported by national policies such as Healthier SG and Age Well SG, we will develop the capabilities to support our population to live long and healthy lives.

sections.label: Healthy Longevity Clinic research participation
sections.summary: The clinic is a research project involving extensive screening tests, and the speaker urges only committed research participants to join as results guide research, not health.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: I think unfortunately, the title "Healthy Longevity Clinic" will attract a lot of people who want to live long.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: But what it actually is, is a research project and it is different from evidence-based screening where it is available on a population basis and already clinical tests, like blood tests, metabolic immune cardiovascular tests, they are all already available under existing programmes and for many of us, it is highly subsidised.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: Whereas this project is really a barrage of screening tests beyond what a person would normally go through.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: It takes a lot of discipline, it takes a lot of commitment and therefore, unless you are committed to be a research participant, I would beseech that you do not participate because this takes a lot of time, and the results are not meant to guide your health but to guide research.
